capabilities.description: Select and coordinate an evidence-gated software engineering lifecycle.
Discover project truth, constraints, conventions, and unresolved decisions.
Investigate technical questions using primary evidence and bounded experiments.
Build domain vocabulary, invariants, relationships, and scenario-tested models.
Produce implementable software specifications with acceptance criteria and non-goals.
Decompose work into an acyclic dependency graph with executable frontiers.
Design software boundaries, seams, interfaces, and architecture decisions.
Implement scoped vertical slices that preserve project architecture.
Design and execute risk-based software verification and regression protection.
Diagnose defects through reproducible feedback loops and evidence.
Review code independently against specification and engineering standards.
Review security boundaries, threats, controls, and evidence.
Integrate changes safely through merge, CI, migrations, release, and rollback.
Transfer compact, redacted, evidence-linked project context across execution boundaries.
Design and refine intentional frontend interfaces.
Adapt frontend design and implementation to WordPress architecture.
Design and review web interfaces for accessible operation.
Design and verify responsive web behavior across viewport and content extremes.
